OPTION_LIFT.description: Lift to gain [gold]1 additional Strength[/gold] at the start of combat. There is no total limit.
OPTION_KINDLE.description: Kindle Pumpkin Candle for 5 more combats. Kindling while active also increases its Energy bonus by 1.
OPTION_CLONE.description: Copy every card in your deck with [gold]Clone[/gold].
OPTION_HATCH.description: Hatch the Byrdonis Eggs in your deck. This can be done once per Rest Site, and the egg count determines the number of Byrdpip cards created.
OPTION_MEND.description: Heal a teammate and trigger the healer's own Rest Site healing-reward relics.
